title: Cap'n Oatmeal #1 Innovation All-American Comics 1990 Champion of Breakfasts
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Cap'n Oatmeal #1 (1990), Innovation / All-American Comics - "Champion of Breakfasts," a cereal-superhero parody. Also features Elephino and Markus J. Moonbeam. Original $2.25 cover price ($2.85 in Canada).

Back cover: Innovation back-cover ad ("Holding a High Standard...") by Thompson/Elliott.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
